title: Unauthorized Data Exposure
description: Child profile data stored in MongoDB may be exposed to unauthorized parties if the database lacks proper access controls, encryption, or network security.
assumptions: MongoDB instance is not properly secured (e.g., exposed to public internet, weak authentication).

title: Child Identifiability
description: Child profiles may contain personally identifiable information (PII) that allows direct or indirect identification of the child.
assumptions: Profile data includes names, birthdates, or other unique identifiers without anonymization.

title: Lack of User Awareness
description: Parents or guardians may not be informed about the storage and processing of their child's profile data.
assumptions: No explicit consent or transparency mechanisms are implemented during profile management.

title: Regulatory Non-Compliance
description: Storing child profiles may violate regulations like COPPA or GDPR if parental consent or data minimization is not enforced.
assumptions: Process does not validate legal requirements for handling children's data.

title: Lack of Audit Trail
description: Updates to child profiles may not be logged, preventing accountability for data modifications.
assumptions: No audit logging is implemented for profile management actions.
